Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with formal language requests so we can close the PO this month. Key asks from our infra and security teams: 

- Availability: 99.95% monthly uptime (measured across the production region serving us).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile (p95) inference response latency <= 500ms (measurement at ingress across production region).
- Evidence: monthly SLA report, 30 days of raw audit logs for requests (timestamped, request id, model variant, region), and SOC2 Type II attestation on file.
- Carveouts we need: scheduled maintenance must be excluded only if notified at least 48 hours in advance; otherwise credit applies.

I've attached a short requirements PDF outlining these items (Mediserv_SLA_Request.pdf). Please confirm whether you can provide the wording as an addendum to the MSA/order form or if you need us to accept standard credits instead. We have a target signature date of Friday (10/08) to meet our internal quarter close.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Thanks,

Ben/Logan — reviewed the redline. A few legal/order-form edits I recommend before sending DocuSign: 

- Availability definition: "Availability" means the Service is successfully accepting and processing requests in the applicable production region. Availability for a monthly period shall be calculated as (1 - total_downtime/total_period_time) * 100. We should define "total_downtime" to exclude agreed maintenance windows, force majeure, and customer-caused outages.
- Latency SLO clause: language to match the customer's ask: "95th percentile (p95) end-to-end inference response latency <= 500ms, measured at the service ingress, excluding cold-starts and experimental model variants."
- Evidence & logs: commit to monthly SLA report and 30 days of request logs in CSV with fields (request_id,timestamp,model_variant,region,response_time_ms). Define delivery method (secure S3 with SSE-KMS) and a 30-day retention. If they require longer retention we can add paid add-on.
- Credit schedule: attach a monetary credit ladder with a maximum of 50% of monthly subscription fee per month. Also recommend an annual cap (e.g., credits not to exceed 2x monthly fee annually).

One commercial ask: if they insist on p95 <= 500ms at scale, we should strongly recommend Dedicated capacity — I note a 12-15% uplift in Ben's outline. Please confirm whether we position the Dedicated option as mandatory for that SLO or as recommended (legal prefers "recommended" unless engineering says otherwise).

I attached a short snippet of suggested order-form wording (SLA_Orderform_Snippet.txt). Once Ben confirms pricing we can finalize the DocuSign envelope.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
